ops.description: Owner-approved optimizations 1-3. Brief and handoff: ~/.local/state/cc-remote/setup-20261002/startup-30s/{brief.md,implementation.json}. Source workflow wf_69910c70-968. ops.text: Package lane installs captured .debs offline with no apt update or download, and maintainer scripts and services stay correct

Opt-in private HTTPS payload source: URL acquired via config, delivered only over remote stdin, one-pass curl|tee|sha256sum, digest admitted before mount, zero URL leakage; streaming stays the default
Repeated immutable tool checks and remote execs reduced; per-machine digest, link, config and readiness checks kept; per-phase start/end timing on stderr
Root fresh benchmark: exact ref, strict SSH, 28 Claude/5 Codex plugins, 6 ready sockets, no node_modules/Tilt
